name: Tower desktop PC
definition: complete desktop computer in a tower case, with the parts fitted.
notes: Dell shop category 'Tower Desktop Computers' with tower models

name: Mini PC
definition: complete desktop computer in a small box, sold as a ready machine.
notes: Dell 'Micro Desktop' category; review table has a Mini PC class

name: All-in-one PC
definition: complete computer with the screen and the computer in one body.
notes: Dell 'All-in-One Desktop Computers' category, 23.8 and 27 inch models

name: Keyboard computer
definition: computer built into its keyboard (historic class).
notes: C64 Wiki: C64 is a keyboard computer, built inside a keyboard; historic home computers

name: Laptop
definition: portable computer with its screen and keyboard in one folding body.
notes: review table device classes and maker list of laptop lines

name: Pocket computer
definition: programmable pocket computer (historic class; provisional until attested).
notes: Sharp PC-1211 of 1980 first pocket computer; pocket computer class article

name: Barebone kit
definition: case, board and power supply sold as the body of a machine, to which the buyer adds the rest.
notes: shops sell barebone mini PCs; Adorama: barebone has case, board, PSU, usually processor

name: Trainer kit
definition: kit sold to teach computing (historic class; provisional until attested).
notes: Heathkit ET-3400 trainer with courses; Micro-Professor MPF-I training system (board, not clearly a kit)

name: Processor
definition: central processing chip (CPU) of a computer.
notes: CPU category with Intel and AMD lines

name: Motherboard [mainboard, Mainboard]
definition: main circuit board of a computer, sold alone.
notes: Kakaku motherboard facets: chipset, socket, form factor

name: Board with CPU fitted
definition: one object sold with the CPU soldered or fitted to the board.
notes: embedded board with CPU soldered; Kakaku CPU socket 'Onboard (138)'; Tsukumo CPU-fitted board group

name: DIMM memory module
definition: full-size memory module for desktop computers.
notes: Tsukumo desktop DIMM tree by DDR generation; Corsair desktop kits

name: SODIMM memory module
definition: small-outline memory module for notebooks and small machines.
notes: Tsukumo notebook SODIMM tree; Corsair VENGEANCE DDR5 SODIMM

name: Graphics card [video card; グラフィックボード; ビデオカード]
native_name: グラフィックボード・ビデオカード
definition: expansion card that renders images for a display or computes in place of a CPU, with or without display outputs.
notes: Tsukumo NVIDIA video cards; ASUS RTX 5090 cards; PCPP Video Cards

name: External GPU enclosure
definition: housing that holds a graphics card outside the computer and connects to it.
notes: Razer Core X V2 and Sonnet Breakaway Box enclosures; card and PSU sold separately

name: PC power supply unit
definition: power supply fitted in a computer case to feed its parts.
notes: UK shop PSU category by brand and wattage; Lian Li ATX and SFX PSUs

name: PC case
definition: enclosure that holds a computer's board, drives and cards.
notes: Lian Li large/medium/small cases; ASUS case series; Tsukumo mid/full tower

name: Air CPU cooler
definition: heatsink with a fan that cools a processor by air.
notes: Noctua air coolers (dual tower, low profile, fanless)

name: All-in-one liquid cooler
definition: sealed pump, radiator and block unit that cools a processor by liquid.
notes: Corsair and Lian Li AIO liquid CPU coolers by radiator size; Noctua NL-LC1

name: Custom-loop parts
definition: separate parts (blocks, radiators, pumps, tubing) for building a liquid cooling loop.
notes: water cooling shop menu: blocks, radiators, pumps, reservoirs, tubing, fittings (menu listing)

name: Case fan
definition: fan fitted to a computer case to move air.
notes: Lian Li UNI FAN and Noctua fans for cases and radiators

name: Thermal paste
native_name: グリス・熱伝導シート
definition: paste applied between a chip and its cooler.
notes: ARCTIC MX-6 paste; Tsukumo grease and thermal sheet group; PCPP Thermal Compound

name: M.2 heatsink
definition: heat spreader fitted to an M.2 drive.
notes: be quiet! MC1 and MC1 Pro M.2 SSD coolers

name: Fan controller
native_name: ファンコントローラー
definition: unit that sets the speed of case fans.
notes: Tsukumo fan controllers (21); PCPP Fan Controllers

name: Sound card
definition: card fitted inside the computer that handles audio (internal only; an external or USB one is D3).
notes: Creative Sound Blaster AE-Series internal PCI-e sound cards; PCPP Sound Cards

name: Network adapter card
definition: card fitted inside the computer that adds a network connection.
notes: Intel PCIe Ethernet adapters; PCPP wired and wireless network adapters

name: Video capture card
definition: card fitted inside the computer that records a video signal.
notes: Elgato Game Capture 4K Pro PCIe; Tsukumo video capture PCI Express group

name: I/O expansion card
definition: card fitted inside the computer that adds ports.
notes: StarTech USB PCIe cards; GIGABYTE GC-TITAN RIDGE Thunderbolt add-in card

name: Internal PC cable
definition: cable that connects parts inside a computer case, including the PCIe riser cable by default.
notes: Lian Li riser cables; Canada Computers PCIe riser category; UK shop Internal PC Cables (176)

name: Dress
definition: One-piece garment covering the torso and extending below the waist, with or without sleeves; length and neckline are attributes.
notes: Sold across lengths (mini, midi, maxi) and types: wrap, shirt, slip, little black dress.

name: Jumper dress (pinafore) [JSK]
definition: Sleeveless dress made to be worn over a blouse or top.
notes: Sold as JSK (lolita) and as pinafore or overall dress; Macys also lists dungaree dress.

name: Dirndl
definition: Traditional Alpine dress of bodice, full skirt and apron.
notes: Dirndl categories split by length (long, midi), sleeves, velvet and bridal; Angermaier sells bodice, blouse, apron.

name: Lehenga choli
definition: South Asian outfit of a long flared skirt (lehenga) and a fitted short blouse (choli), usually with a dupatta.
notes: Myntra category Lehenga Choli (11,715 items); product titles show lehenga choli sets.

name: Ruqun
definition: Traditional Chinese two-piece dress of an upper garment and a wrapped skirt.
notes: Sold as qixiong (chest-high) and qiyao (waist-high) ruqun, often as sets with outer robe and pibo shawl.

name: Overalls (dungarees)
definition: Trousers with a bib and shoulder straps, worn over or without a top.
notes: Called dungarees in UK/EU and bib overalls in US; sold as bib-and-brace work garment.

name: Jumpsuit
definition: One-piece garment joining a top and trousers.
notes: Category Jumpsuits and Rompers; wide-leg, halter, wrap-look jumpsuits.

name: Boiler suit
definition: One-piece work garment with sleeves and legs, worn over other clothing.
notes: UK/EU shops call it boiler suit; US shops call it coverall; insulated and hi-vis types exist.

name: Bee suit
definition: One-piece protective suit with a veil or hood, worn by beekeepers.
notes: Sold with attached veil or hood; ventilated, economy and professional types; all-in-one suit by Thorne.

name: Costume
definition: Dress-up outfit sold as a set, with no single garment form.
notes: Sold as complete costume sets with several pieces, mostly themed or licensed.

name: Business suit
definition: Tailored set of a jacket with matching trousers or skirt, for business and formal day wear.
notes: Sold as two-piece suit of jacket and trousers; separates and three-piece also listed.

name: Tuxedo
definition: Formal evening suit with satin or grosgrain facings, worn with a bow tie.
notes: Sold as tuxedo with satin lapels or satin-edged lapels; notch and shawl lapel.

name: Sari
definition: Long unstitched length of cloth draped round the body over a blouse and petticoat.
notes: Myntra category Sarees (442,519 items); Nalli and Zari Banaras sell sarees by weave.

name: Kimono
definition: Traditional Japanese T-shaped wrapped robe; type (furisode, houmongi, komon, tomesode, iromuji) is a named form and formality an attribute.
notes: Shops file kimono by type: furisode, tomesode, houmongi, tsukesage, iromuji, komon; vintage and used.

name: Yukata
definition: Unlined cotton summer robe of Japanese dress.
notes: Yukata sold as own category: casual summer cotton kimono worn without nagajuban.

name: Sarong (kanga)
definition: Length of cloth wrapped round the waist or body.
notes: Beach sarongs/pareos sold by swimwear brands; kanga and kikoi cloths sold by Kenyan stores; lungi.

name: Dhoti
definition: Length of cloth wrapped and tied round the waist and legs by men in South Asian dress.
notes: Sold as dhoti, veshti, mundu (Kerala); single, double and ready-to-wear types.

name: Dupatta
definition: Long scarf-like length of cloth worn over the shoulders or head with South Asian dress.
notes: Myntra category Dupatta (20,174 items); craft types such as Banarasi, Phulkari, Bandhani.

name: Shawl (stole)
definition: Rectangular or triangular length of cloth worn over the shoulders or arms.
notes: Sold as shawls (Kani, Aari) and as stoles and scarves; cashmere stole.

name: Blazer (sport coat)
definition: Tailored jacket worn without matching trousers, including school and club blazers.
notes: Sold as sport coats and blazers in wool, linen, suede and tweed; Brooks Brothers lists navy blazers.

name: MA-1 flight jacket
definition: Short nylon bomber jacket with ribbed collar, cuffs and hem, in the MA-1 pattern.
notes: Alpha sells MA-1 as its original icon with orange lining; Schott 237 is a leather MA-1.

name: M-65 field jacket
definition: Cotton field jacket with four pockets and a concealed hood, in the M-65 pattern.
notes: Alpha M-65 field jacket: four front pockets, stand collar, hood; sold in olive, black, woodland camo.

name: Harrington jacket
definition: Short lightweight zip jacket with a stand collar and a tartan lining.
notes: Baracuta G9: two-button collar, ribbed cuffs and hem, Fraser Tartan lining; made in UK.

name: Coach jacket
definition: Short unlined nylon jacket with a snap front and a collar.
notes: Nylon, snap front, raglan sleeves; Heamco version lined with polyester tricot; named for US sideline coaches.

name: Trucker jacket
definition: Short work jacket with a pointed collar, chest pockets and button front, in denim, corduroy or other fabric.
notes: Carhartt WIP OG Trucker in canvas; Levi's Type III Trucker in denim, original jean jacket since 1967.

name: Chore coat
definition: Boxy workwear jacket with a button front and patch pockets.
notes: Carhartt WIP Michigan Chore Coat unlined canvas, patch pockets; OG Chore Coat cut more boxy.

name: Souvenir jacket [sukajan]
definition: Embroidered satin bomber-style jacket in the Japanese souvenir jacket tradition.
notes: Satin souvenir bomber with dragon and tiger embroidery; Eiyo says made for US soldiers in postwar Japan.

name: Varsity jacket
definition: Wool body and leather sleeves jacket with a ribbed collar, cuffs and hem, as worn by school and college teams.
notes: Golden Bear sells melton wool body with leather sleeves, knit trim, snap front; also all-wool versions.

name: Rider's jacket (biker jacket)
definition: Close-fitting short jacket of leather or other tough material cut for motorcycle riding, with an asymmetric zip front.
notes: Asymmetric Perfecto in steerhide or cowhide, quilted nylon liner; Schott also sells cafe racer and split-collar styles.

name: Mountain parka
definition: Hooded outdoor jacket of waterproof or windproof fabric, cut for hill and mountain use.
notes: TNF Mountain Jacket is a hooded waterproof shell; its parkas are insulated, for high altitude.

name: Shell jacket
definition: Waterproof or windproof jacket with no insulation, for rain and wind.
notes: Arc'teryx splits shells into hardshell, softshell and windshell; none insulated.

name: Fleece jacket
definition: Zip-front jacket of napped synthetic pile; the material is the form.
notes: TNF sells full-zip jackets of recycled Polartec fleece; Denali, Glacier and Yumiori lines.

name: Puffer jacket
definition: Quilted insulated jacket, down or synthetic filled, ending at the hip or above; fill and fill power are attributes.
notes: TNF Nuptse is a 700-fill down jacket; Gloverall sells a Dufflewool puffa jacket.

name: Chef's jacket
definition: Double-breasted, white or dark cotton jacket worn by cooks.
notes: Mostly double-breasted, many short-sleeved; also asymmetrical and snap-front chef coats.

name: Haori
definition: Traditional Japanese hip-length jacket worn over a kimono.
notes: Page says hip-length, open front, worn over kimono; sold as streetwear cardigan; narrow collar.

name: Trench coat
definition: Belted, double-breasted raincoat with shoulder straps and a storm flap.
notes: Burberry Kensington: double-breasted, belt, epaulettes, storm shield, cotton gabardine; Gloverall Bacall is cropped.

name: Pea coat
definition: Short, double-breasted wool coat with wide lapels and slash pockets.
notes: Gloverall Churchill; Sterlingwear copies USN peacoat in 24oz melton; Schott 140 is leather.

name: Duffle coat
definition: Hooded wool coat fastened with toggles and loops.
notes: Gloverall Original Monty: knee-length, wooden toggles on jute loops, wide hood, 1951 pattern.

name: Puffer coat
definition: Quilted insulated coat, down or synthetic filled, ending below the hip; fill and fill power are attributes.
notes: UNIQLO Seamless Down Long Coat; TNF Arctic Parka down, above-knee; Parka also hip-length variants.

name: Beizi
definition: Traditional Chinese long side-opening outer garment.
notes: Open-front long jacket from the Song period, hip to ankle length; women's hanfu layer.

name: Puffer vest
definition: Sleeveless quilted insulated vest, down or synthetic filled.
notes: TNF 1996 Retro Nuptse Gilet 700-fill down; Moncler Tibb Down Gilet.

name: Cut-off vest (battle vest)
definition: Sleeveless denim or leather vest with its sleeves cut off, worn as a base for patches.
notes: Also called kutte or cut; denim or leather, patched; battle vest when sleeveless.

name: Waistcoat
definition: Fitted sleeveless tailored garment worn under a jacket or alone.
notes: Wool and linen waistcoats, single and double-breasted, tuxedo waistcoats, sold to match suits.

name: Hi-vis vest
definition: Sleeveless fluorescent vest with reflective bands, worn for visibility.
notes: ANSI Class 2 mesh vests with reflective tape, zip or Velcro closure; yellow-green or orange.

name: Life jacket
definition: Buoyant vest or jacket worn to keep the wearer afloat.
notes: Foam PFD vests approved by US Coast Guard; also dual-flotation PFDs and buoyancy aids.

name: Poncho
definition: Outer garment of a single piece of cloth with a head opening and no sleeves.
notes: Poncho-Boutique sells wool, rain, cycling and blanket ponchos; poncho capes also sold.

name: Cape (cloak)
definition: Sleeveless outer garment hanging from the shoulders, open at the front.
notes: Capes and cloaks in cashmere, wool, gabardine; some sleeveless; filed with ponchos.

name: Internal SSD
definition: solid-state drive fitted inside a computer, of any interface or size (M.2 or 2.5-inch).
notes: Best Buy CA category list has Internal SSD; PCPartPicker storage filter has SSD type

name: Internal HDD
definition: spinning-disk drive fitted inside a computer.
notes: Internal Hard Drives category; PCPartPicker lists 5400/5900/7200 RPM drives

name: External SSD
definition: solid-state drive in its own case, connected from outside.
notes: External SSD category; PCPartPicker external storage has SSD option

name: External HDD
definition: spinning-disk drive in its own case, connected from outside.
notes: External Hard Drives category; RPM options 5400-7200 on PCPartPicker

name: USB flash drive
definition: small flash storage device that plugs into a USB port.
notes: B&H USB flash drive category with USB-A, USB-C and dual-connector models

name: Memory card
definition: flash card of a standard format (SD, microSD, CompactFlash, CFexpress); a proprietary console-only card is D5.
notes: CDW memory cards: SD, microSD, CompactFlash, CFast and CFexpress form factors

name: Drive enclosure
definition: housing that turns a bare drive into an external drive.
notes: Enclosures for 2.5/3.5 inch and M.2 NVMe drives sold as external enclosures

name: Optical drive
definition: drive that reads or writes discs.
notes: PCPartPicker optical drive category; Best Buy CA Optical Drives & Media category

name: NAS
definition: network-attached storage device that holds drives and serves files over a network (a recorder sold only to run security cameras is B8).
notes: NAS category with bay counts; diskless and populated units

name: Keyboard
definition: key-based input device (size class is an attribute).
notes: Keyboard category with manufacturer and switch filters

name: Linear keyboard switch
definition: loose keyboard switch with a smooth press and no bump or click.
notes: Switch table lists Linear type loose switches (Cherry MX Red, Gateron, Kailh)

name: Tactile keyboard switch
definition: loose keyboard switch with a felt bump and no click.
notes: Switch table lists Tactile type switches (Cherry MX Brown, Clear, Kailh)

name: Clicky keyboard switch
definition: loose keyboard switch with a felt bump and an audible click.
notes: Switch table lists Clicky type switches (Cherry MX Blue, Green, Kailh BOX)

name: Mouse
definition: hand-held pointing device moved over a surface.
notes: Mouse category with manufacturer and tracking-method filters

name: Trackball
definition: pointing device operated by a fixed ball.
notes: Mouse category tracking-method filter includes Trackball

name: Monitor
definition: display sold for use with a computer.
notes: Monitor category with manufacturer filters Acer Asus LG MSI Samsung

name: Webcam
definition: camera made for use with a computer.
notes: Webcam category; Elgato, Logitech, OBSBOT, UGREEN

name: Pen tablet
definition: drawing tablet used with a pen, with or without a built-in screen (a pen display is a pen tablet with a screen).
notes: Pen tablets and pen displays both sold; Wacom One is both display and tablet

name: 3D printer
definition: machine that builds objects by additive manufacturing.
notes: FDM and resin 3D printers sold by makers directly

name: Memory-card reader
definition: device that reads memory cards and connects to a computer.
notes: Card readers with SD, microSD, CFexpress slots, USB-C connection

name: Barcode scanner
definition: device that reads barcodes.
notes: Handheld 1D/2D barcode scanners, corded and cordless

name: KVM switch
definition: switch that shares one keyboard, display and mouse between several computers.
notes: KVM switches 2-16 port with USB, HDMI, DisplayPort, VGA

name: Multifunction printer
definition: machine that prints and scans (and copies) for use with a computer.
notes: All-in-one print, scan, copy, fax inkjet and laser machines

name: Scanner
definition: machine that scans documents or images into a computer.
notes: Document and photo scanners, sheet-fed and portable (Epson, Fujitsu ScanSnap)

name: Keyboard kit
definition: case, plate and circuit board sold to be built into a keyboard.
notes: Kits sold barebones: case, PCB, plate, stabilizers; switches and keycaps bought separately

name: Numeric keypad
definition: separate input device with number keys.
notes: External USB numeric keypads, wired 19-key and wireless

name: Video capture device
definition: external device that records a video signal into a computer (connection is an attribute).
notes: External USB capture cards record HDMI game/camera signal; Cam Link capture also listed

name: Floppy disk drive
definition: drive that reads or writes floppy disks.
notes: External USB 3.5 inch 1.44 MB floppy drive sold as a product

name: Printer
definition: machine that prints from a computer.
notes: Single-function laser and inkjet printers (B&H Single Function filter)

name: Speech microphone
definition: microphone made for speech, calls or streaming.
notes: USB microphones sold for streaming, podcasts and calls (Elgato Wave:3, Shure MV7, Blue Yeti)
